svg.title: The pretty-svg-docs style catalog — 32 idioms
svg.desc: A contact sheet of thirty-two animated style specimens in alphabetical order, two to a row. Every cell is that style’s own full specimen scaled down, so each carries its real filter chains, grain and lighting rather than a flattened imitation.
svg.text: Source, Transform, Store — the same diagram in every idiom, alphabetically

g.text: one gutter, one focal cell, one moving tile
nota bene — il flusso non si ferma
elevation 1 for cards, elevation 4 for the bar
the glass samples what is actually behind it
frost 14 · refract 18 · one light pool across all six surfaces
volume implies cost; the tallest stage is the transform
lorem ipsum placeholder — do not ship
LOUD ON PURPOSE — FOUR RATES, NO MORE
raised and pressed, one light source
olio su tela — impasto, luce da 235°
SHEET 3 OF 7 — APPARATUS FOR CONVEYING DATA
REF DES: U1 U2 U3 — REV C
one light vector, warm occlusion, translucent edges
Labels sit on slabs, never on a shaded form
volume lives in the fill — strip every filter and the forms still read solid
wet on wet — edges left to dry

svg.text: every tile is the style’s own specimen,
scaled — not a redrawing of it
each gated at its declared filter floor
Each specimen also ships full-width under docs/samples/
